title: Keep an ignored-type convention working
goal: Migrate an ignored-type notification convention and check callback dispatch, model inclusion, schema and persistence on actual SQLite.

selectionNotes: The legacy IEntityTypeIgnoredConvention is already obsolete on EF10 and its registered callback is not dispatched by this measured graph. ITypeIgnoredConvention is available on both releases. Use the replacement before upgrading; do not describe it as newly introduced in EF11. Register through ConfigureConventions. Verify ignoring both before and after explicit entity addition in separate processes. This observer records notification; ModelBuilder.Ignore owns exclusion. It does not silently enforce a policy against later explicit re-addition. No annotation-removal call is needed in this observer; HasNoAnnotation is the builder replacement only where such a call exists.
